mapper.select: select id, member_type, role_id, name, account_status, qualification_status, borrowed_book_count, permanent_borrow_limit, temporary_borrow_limit, temporary_quota_expires_at, version from member where id = #{id}
mapper.update:
update member set borrowed_book_count = borrowed_book_count + 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and account_status = 'ACTIVE' and qualification_status = 'APPROVED'
and borrowed_book_count < case when temporary_borrow_limit is not null and temporary_quota_expires_at > #{now} then temporary_borrow_limit else permanent_borrow_limit end and version = #{version}
update member set borrowed_book_count = borrowed_book_count - 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and borrowed_book_count > 0 and version = #{version}
